articles.title: How to Watch My Hero Academia in Order
articles.summary: As the superhero anime prepares for its final season, here's a a full guide to watching My Hero Academia in order, including movies and OVAs.
articles.body:
My Hero Academia came out at the perfect time, releasing just a couple of years before Infinity War, at the height of superhero dominance of pop culture. While Marvel movies were delivering world-ending stakes, the simplicity and relatively small scope of My Hero Academia felt new and refreshing even if it was familiar — especially to anyone who watched Sky High in the mid-'00s. The show is just a very effective battle shonen with everything you'd expect from a series in the genre, including memorable characters, themes about friendship and self-improvement, a sense of escalation, and stunning animation.

But most importantly, the show has an interesting portrayal of a world of heroes where superpowers impact every single aspect of culture and society. Like most shonen, there is plenty of supplementary material, like movies and original video animation (OVAs) and even spin-offs that expand the world of the anime. Whether you're just getting into the show or you want to see what you've missed along the way, here's how to watch My Hero Academia (including the movies) in order.

Adapting Kōhei Horikoshi's manga of the same name, My Hero Academia aired for eight seasons across 170 episodes and nearly an entire decade. In addition to the main show, there have been ten OVA's that expand the story, either with silly little side stories or adaptations of one-shot manga, as well as four movies. My Hero Academia: Vigilantes is the first and only anime spin-off so far.

How about canon, though? Well, anything that doesn't directly adapt the manga, like the movies and most of the OVAs, aren't technically canon. Sure, they're fun and the movies do often tease some new power-up that is to come in the anime later on, but they're not necessary to the story.

Almost everything MHA, including every season of the show (Season 8 is currently airing), most of the OVAs, and all four movies, is streaming on Crunchyroll. The best anime streaming service , Crunchyroll offers an ad-supported free tier as well as a seven-day free trial of its Premium membership, which starts at $7.99/month. In the U.S., all seven seasons of My Hero Academia are streaming on Hulu, while the first four seasons are on Netflix. The My Hero Academia movies are also available as physical releases.

How to Watch My Hero Academia in Chronological Order

1. Spin-Off: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes

Absolutely not where anyone should start their MHA viewing experience, but the recent anime adaptation of Hideyuki Furuhashi's prequel manga technically takes before the events of the main MHA story. Following the emergence of underground "vigilantes," the season includes background about some of the main characters and plotlines in the series.

2. My Hero Academia Season 1 (Episodes 1-13)

3. OVA: My Hero Academia: Save! Rescue Training!

The first My Hero Academia OVA that was released feels like a blast from the past, an episode that is entirely about the students of class 1A and the teachers reeling from the USJ Incident from the first season. Now, the students are finally set to resume training, and they make groups as they are assigned to rescue each other, then face a fight against a villain.

Because the episode was only released in Japan at the annual Jump Festa fan convention celebrating the various Shōnen manga magazines, the OVA is full of funny fourth-wall breaks and nods to the audience.

4. My Hero Academia Season 2 (Episodes 14-38)

5. OVA: My Hero Academia: Training of the Dead

Teacher Aizawa is a little bit unorthodox. In this second OVA, he decides to throw his students headfirst into a training exercise with students from the Isamu Academy High School – which spirals out of control when one of the students (named Romero in a touching tribute to the father of modern zombies) uses his Quirk and turns a whole bunch of people into zombies. What was meant to be a simple exercise about survival turns into a proper zombie apocalypse. The OVA has some hilarious moments like seeing the panic in Deku's eyes when he sees All Might in his weakened state, only for everyone to think he's a zombie.

6. OVA: My Hero Academia: All Might Rising

While this OVA could have technically kicked off the timeline, it's best enjoyed as a prologue to the Two Heroes movie it released alongside. This is as close as we got to a proper All Might prequel, and it is delightful to watch All Might rise from a grieving student who just lost his teacher to becoming the ever-smiling Symbol of Peace we know and love.

The first My Hero Academia movie sets the winning formula that would follow in every movie in the franchise since. What starts out as a fun getaway vacation where Deku accompanies All Might to visit an old friend of the hero ends up as a big test to Deku as the floating island is taken hostage by a villain. This is the movie for All Might fans as we learn a bit more of his origin and his time in America.

8. My Hero Academia Season 3 (Episodes 39-63)

9. OVA: Make It! Do-or-Die Survival Training

Why does every Class 1-A training exercise end in disaster? This time around, the entire abandoned mall that the teacher decided to set this training in starts to collapse and the training exercise quickly becomes a fight for survival. These episodes are really for those who don't like that the main story moved away from the school part of the story too quickly, and delivers the kind of Saturday Morning Cartoon-type school shenanigans of the earlier seasons.

10. My Hero Academia Season 4 (Episodes 64-88)

This is by far my favorite My Hero Academia movie to date. Heroes Rising showcases Class 1-A working together as proper heroes without relying on a mentor, a cool location, and also a cameo from the best hero, Godzillo. Most importantly, this movie is a treat for Bakugo and Deku fans, giving us more insight into their relationship and dynamic. It also has the best climax of any of the movies by having Deku and Bakugo work together and deliver a phenomenal joint attack.

12. My Hero Academia Season 5 (Episodes 88-106)

This is another short OVA, and one that actually adapts a one-shot from the manga. It is mostly a comedy sketch about Hawks that ties into the next movie, but what makes it stand out is its stunning animation.

14. My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission

This movie has the highest stakes of the movies up to this point and a cool visual style, but what really makes World Heroes' Mission special is the introduction of best boy, Rody. He instantly becomes one of the best characters in the franchise and seeing his dynamic with Deku is fantastic. Timeline-wise, this is the one place My Hero Academia gets a bit funky, as the anime deviates from the manga.

15. My Hero Academia Season 5 (Episodes 107-113)

What if our favorite heroes had to stop a criminal whose power made everyone around him laugh uncontrollably? That's the simple but sweet premise of this OVA, which is one of the funniest episodes of My Hero Academia. The villain is essentially a Joker type who makes everyone laughs and he is a treat to watch, even if the episode itself doesn't offer much that we hadn't seen before.

A baseball episode! A classic trope of the anime medium, and one that My Hero Academia does spectacularly. Sure, there are few surprises to be had, but that's fine, because the fun is just watching the wild display of Quirks used for something as mundane as a sports match.

18. My Hero Academia Season 6 (Episodes 114-138)

What if My Hero Academia turned into Yu-Gi-Oh? Bored during Winter Break and sequestered in their dorms, the 1-A students pass the time by playing a new heroes card game. It's essentially an excuse to show the characters battle each other (in a VR recreation of the card characters battling it out), but it is great "what if" fun – like seeing All Might fight… a dog.

20. My Hero Academia Season 7 (Episodes 139-159)

Deku is a huge hero nerd, that much audiences have known from the start, but sometimes the anime seems to forget about it. That's where A Piece of Cake comes from, adapting a one-shot manga that's all about the 1-A students discovering Deku's journal with extensive notes about their Quirks, and having wild reactions to his tips, suggestions, and silly drawings. It's a fun rest in what's otherwise a rather bleak chapter in the story, and a fun side story where the kids get to be kids (possibly for the last time).

The latest My Hero Academia movie has some jaw-dropping visuals and a great final fight. The story introduces fascinating characters, including an anti-All Might villain as well as a new protagonist that has great chemistry with our main heroes.

My Hero Academia concluded its run with an epic all-out war between All For One and One For All. Virtually every character we met along the show’s run returned one last time to aid in the final fight, bringing the story to an emotional conclusion.

To celebate the My Hero Academia anime's tenth anniversary, the series released an anime adaptation of an epilogue chapter called "More" in early May. Taking place eight years after the anime's conclusion, the special shows Deku's friends pitching in to get the MC a new high-tech hero suit and provides some closure on Deku and Ochaku's relationship.

OVA: Make It! Do-or-Die Survival Training (2020)

My Hero Academia: World Heroes Mission (2021)

OVA: Laugh! As If You Are in Hell (2022)

Though the main My Hero Academia anime is over, the Vigilantes spin-off is currently airing its second season. It's also not entirely over for the OG cast, either, seeing as we just got an adaptation of Chapter 431 of the original manga. Following the release of Episode 171, official MHA accounts confirmed that a spin-off anime based on I Am A Hero Too will release this summer.

Rafael Motamayor is a contributing freelancer for IGN covering everything anime and animation.

articles.title: GTA 6 Is a 'Single-Player Experience,' Rockstar Confirms — What Now for GTA Online?
articles.summary: GTA 6 is a “single-player experience,” Rockstar has confirmed in a note sent to IGN, as well as on storefronts where you can now preorder the game. This suggests the $80 base game does not include any new version of GTA Online, should such an experience be in the works.
articles.body:
GTA 6 is a “single-player experience,” Rockstar has confirmed in a note sent to IGN, as well as on storefronts where you can now preorder the game. This suggests the $80 base game does not include any new version of GTA Online, should such an experience be in the works.

While many are assuming Rockstar plans to release a new and improved GTA Online at some point in the future, there remains questions over how it will be released. Will Rockstar release a new GTA Online for free within GTA 6? Or will it release it as a standalone experience, potentially charging more?

Rockstar’s announcements today have made it clear that the existing GTA Online is the focus for now. A digital preorder gets you a free month of GTA+, with Rockstar referencing GTA Online in its press release:

"Experience the dynamic blockbuster GTA Online now with the best way to get the most out of its ever-evolving world. Pre-order any edition of Grand Theft Auto VI on the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store and get one free month of GTA+ — featuring a recurring monthly GTA$500,000 deposit into your GTA Online character's bank account, access to special Shark Cards with 15% bonus GTA$, access to free and discounted GTA Online vehicles, a rotating selection of classic Rockstar Games titles and other featured games in the GTA+ Games Library, and much more."

Perhaps we shouldn’t be surprised by the lack of a new GTA Online for GTA 6 at launch. GTA Online continues to print money for Rockstar and parent company Take-Two , and its availability on PC, where GTA 6 will not be available day one, will surely maintain its momentum even as GTA 6 hits PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.

Last year, IGN asked Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick about the fate of GTA Online , and in his response he referenced NBA 2K Online, the free-to-play online-focused version of 2K Sports’ hugely successful basketball franchise aimed at the Asian market. NBA 2K Online launched all the way back in 2012, and then 2K Sports released NBA 2K Online 2 in 2017. Both games were maintained simultaneously, so fans of the first version could continue to play and invest their time and money safe in the knowledge they wouldn’t be left behind.

“I'm going to speak theoretically only because I'm not going to talk about a particular project when an announcement hasn't been made,” Zelnick began. “But generally speaking, we support our properties when the consumers are involved with those titles. As an example, we launched NBA 2K Online in China, I think originally in 2012 if I'm not mistaken. And then we launched NBA 2K Online 2 in China in 2017. If I'm not mistaken. We did not sunset Online 1. They both are still in the market and they serve consumers and they're alive and we have this massive audience.

“So we've shown a willingness to support legacy titles when a community wants to be engaged with them.”

GTA 6 Vintage Vice City Pack Screenshots

That last line is of particular importance. It suggests — but doesn’t confirm at this stage — that if there is a GTA Online 2, it won’t come at the cost of GTA Online falling by the wayside. If people keep playing GTA Online, Zelnick is suggesting here, then Rockstar will continue to support it.

So, while a new GTA Online feels inevitable, perhaps fans shouldn’t hold their breath for its release. While you wait, we've got plenty more on GTA 6 following today's announcement, including confirmation of the GTA 6 price , over 60 new GTA 6 screenshots , and Sony's boast that GTA 6 "plays best" on PS5 .

articles.title: GTA 6 Fans Think They Spotted a Lore Mistake, but It's Likely on Purpose
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI fans think Rockstar may have messed up when it comes to its own lore, but there may be more than meets the eye.
articles.body:
Grand Theft Auto 6 fans think Rockstar might've messed up when it comes to its own lore, but there may be more to it than meets the eye.

In GTA 6's $100 Ultimate Edition, players will get access to a set of powerful revolvers, one for each protagonist. In the official description for the Hawk & Little Morgan Revolver, Rockstar states that they've been "sourced exclusively from the Vercetti Estate," suggesting that they were taken from the mansion that Tommy Vercetti owns in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. However, there is one big problem: Tommy Vercetti isn't supposed to exist in this GTA universe.

Rockstar Games did a Q&A in 2011 and revealed that the series' PS2-era games are set in a different universe from the "HD games" (Xbox 360-era and onward). As such, players shouldn't expect major characters to cross over, with the only real exception applying to a few background characters like Lazlow.

"The 'universes' are the worlds interpreted at different definitions, 2D, 3D, and high definition, so we felt brands and radio/background characters would exist in both, but three-dimensional characters would not," said Rockstar. "This is the logic (as far as it could be considered logical) behind it – so no, we don’t believe any GTA 3 characters could exist in the GTA 4 universe."

So, what's going on here? The simplest and most likely explanation is that it's nothing more than an Easter egg. Grove Street was featured in Grand Theft Auto 5, along with the Ballas gang, but it doesn't necessarily mean CJ and his crew exist in GTA 5. A similar case could be made that the Vercetti Estate is simply a nod to the franchise's history, in name only. It's also not the only reference to Tommy in GTA 6.

A painting of a lizard wearing Tommy's shirt can be spotted in the second GTA 6 trailer , and the pre-order bonus for the game adds weapon skins that resemble his shirt's pattern. The second GTA 6 trailer also featured a glimpse at what appears to be a new version of Phil Cassidy, a character that was originally in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City.

In GTA 6, Phil owns a gun store and has both of his arms, unlike his 3D-era counterpart. He also appears to be in his 30s or 40s, whereas Phil from GTA: Vice City would likely be in his 70s. All this is to say that Rockstar may be playing a bit fast and loose with its universe. Maybe there's a new version of Tommy Vercetti in GTA 6, similar to Phil. Or maybe it's all just a fun Easter egg that we shouldn't spend much time picking apart.

In related news, Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 will cost a whopping $80 and the game won't be released on a physical disc . The developer also dropped more than 60 new screenshots , which show off the game's wide range of customization options, vehicles, and weapons. Rockstar is still keeping a tight lid on any plans for GTA Online's future, though, as a store page for the game refers to the title as a "single player" experience .

Grand Theft Auto 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5, the latter of which is being marketed as the best place to play the game .

articles.title: Rhaenyra Finally Acts Fast in This Week's House of the Dragon, Even as She Immediately Finds New Mistakes to Make
articles.summary: In this week's House of the Dragon, Rhaenyra’s eyes are fixed on the throne – but her one-track focus may be causing her to miss things.
articles.body:
Full spoilers follow for House of the Dragon Season 3, Episode 2.

After the all-out warfare of last week , you might be expecting a bit of a breather this time, and maybe even worrying that the show will once again slow to a crawl as it did after the Battle of Rook’s Rest last season. But fear not! The aftershocks of the Battle of the Gullet are still reverberating, and the Black Queen is not derailed completely by grief this time. In fact, she’s swinging into action in a way we’ve never seen before.

House of the Dragon: Season 3 Official Images

Of course, there are a few matters to clear up first. Alyn of Hull (Abubakar Salim) and his brother Addam (Clinton Liberty), aboard the dragon Seasmoke, hunt for and find their missing father Corlys (Steve Toussaint). The admiral is heartbroken but otherwise relatively unscathed by the loss of his flagship and treasure house. “If this is victory, I hope I never see another,” he mourns. But there is the upside of a little family reunion there; Alyn gets to meet and develop mutual respect with his niece Baela (Bethany Antonia), and the whole family have a nice moment of bonding when Corlys offers to legitimize his two sons. Awww. Is it weird that this lot are the closest we seem to have to a positive family of (relative) role models like the Starks? Yes, they’re still down with the whole incest thing, but at least they don’t seem to actively dislike one another, and Alyn and Addam / Baela and Rhaena seem actively fond of one another.

Meanwhile, Tyroshi pirates and Jefferson Hall’s Tyland Lannister, incidentally, make it to shore and, in the former’s case, set about causing havoc to try to get some arms and equipment. Along the way they accidentally free Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Lord Larys Strong (Matthew Needham) from their temporary captivity, and the two scarper off to Rook’s Rest – the site where Aegon’s injury occurred – in search of allies. They’re hoping to find Ser Criston Cole (Fabien Frankel), but he’s hurried off to Harrenhal after spotting Aemond (Ewan Mitchell) and his massive dragon Vhagar headed in that direction. Gee, it sure would be nice if Ulf, Hugh and Addam were still lying in wait to ambush Aemond there now. Oh, and Rhaena (Phoebe Campbell) is up in the Vale, begging for sanctuary from Lady Jeyne Arryn (Amanda Collin) after contributing to her cousin/step-brother/planned-future brother-in-law’s death. She doesn’t get any comfort there, just bad news, with Rhaenyra out to kill this mysterious dragonrider.

Back in the capital, Alicent (Olivia Cooke) is plotting furiously to deliver on the deal she made with Rhaenyra (Emma D’Arcy). All does not go to plan. She negotiates a forest of penises to make some sort of deal with the head of the City Watch, aka the Gold Cloaks (their watchhouse appears to double as a bathhouse), but due to Aemond’s late departure and a horrific attempted rape by Lord Jasper Wylde (Paul Kennedy), interrupted just in time by Grand Maester Orwyle (Kurt Egyiawan), she’s running behind. She gets to the guards on the wall and tells them to let Rhaenyra’s dragons past the harpoons, but struggles to get out of the city with Helaena (Phia Saban) and her tiny daughter fast enough. This is classic Game of Thrones-style plotting: a city faces an enemy force and a sneaky faction inside moves to let them in. It’s also typical plotting in that all does not go to plan for the conspirators.

That’s because, for once, Rhaenyra acts relatively fast. Yes, she seems to be falling apart at the beginning of the episode when she sees Jace’s (Harry Collett) corpse, but with Daemon (Matt Smith) back at her side and, more importantly, on her side in a way that he was not when she last lost a son, she is still fired up at the prospect of retaking the throne that she believes was stolen from her. But it’s interesting to see that, almost immediately, she finds new mistakes to make. She rails against her Small Council’s caution, to their faces, and questions the loyalty of her Queensguard, first rejecting Ser Lorent’s (Max Wrottesley) offer of his life in return for his failure to stop Jace, and then appearing to reconsider later (“Let Ser Lorent choose how he will die”). Later, after she arrives in King’s Landing alongside Daemon, with the new dragonriders Ulf (Tom Bennett) and Hugh (Kieran Bew) behind her, she hesitates at fatal moments. She visibly recoils from killing that old puppetmaster Otto Hightower (Rhys Ifans) and then makes a bad job of it.

Daemon, called away from partying with the Riverlords, also makes what could be serious errors. He scoffs at the witch Alys’ (Gayle Rankin) request for a reward for her help (to be fair, she asks for Harrenhal, which has assumed an outsize importance in the mind of everyone in this war). Later, he is patronising and rude to the “Dragonseeds.” Now yes, Ulf is a fool, and greets him as an equal, and that was always going to put his back up, but they are allies with great big stonking dragons behind them, and a wise man might consider the value of welcoming them into the family. Daemon has an object lesson in the value of loyalty this episode, when his ol’ buddies in the Gold Cloaks swing behind him in the bid for Rhaenyra’s throne, so it’s positively infuriating to see him at his arrogant worst around Alys and Ulf – even if he shows an edge of respect to Hugh. This is the downside of focusing on royalty all the time in this show; they have these blind spots.

Rhaenyra too is prone to missteps. She shouldn’t have hesitated to kill Otto, even if it upset her BFF. As it is, she leaves a trail of bloody footsteps to the throne – think of the metaphor, Rhaenyra! Don’t give your enemies that ammunition – and takes her seat with a face that’s snotty and wet with tears. When Alicent and Helaena are brought in front of her at just that moment as prisoners, she looks stricken, but tries to muster some defiance. Pull it together, woman; you’re a queen now.

Still, that’s a lot of progress for just one episode. The Ironrod and former Hand of the King are both dead, and the two Green Queens are now in custody. The Iron Throne is in Rhaenyra’s hands, with Daemon for once standing by her, and several sons still left to inherit. Looks like she has this whole civil war sewn up. It’s amazing there are six episodes left this season, really. What could possibly go wrong?

articles.title: Por que GTA 6 não é recomendado para menores de 18 anos — e o alerta de psiquiatras e psicólogos | G1
articles.standfirst: Considerado o maior lançamento da história dos games, 'Grand Theft Auto VI' estreou nesta quinta-feira (19/11) e pode trazer preocupação aos pais.
articles.summary: Considerado o maior lançamento da história dos games, 'Grand Theft Auto VI' estreou nesta quinta-feira (19/11) e pode trazer preocupação aos pais.
articles.body:
Jason e Lucia, os personagens principais de GTA 6, em assalto a banco — Foto: Rockstar via BBC

O café da manhã de muitas famílias nesta quarta-feira (19/11) pode ter sido acompanhado de uma pergunta indigesta: "Pai/mãe, por que não posso jogar Grand Theft Auto VI , o GTA 6 , maior lançamento da história dos videogames ?"

Se levada em conta a classificação indicativa de 18 anos obtida pela desenvolvedora do game junto ao Ministério da Justiça — em razão das cenas de violência , sexo e uso de drogas presentes na história —, a resposta é simples: não.

Na prática, porém, a decisão envolve dilemas mais complexos. Como lidar com filhos de diferentes idades dentro de casa? E quando os próprios pais também querem se divertir com o game? Há, ainda, o receio de que restringir o acesso ao jogo acabe excluindo a criança das conversas e interações com os amigos na escola.

Para os especialistas em saúde mental consultados pela BBC News Brasil, os pais devem respeitar a classificação indicativa.

"A classificação está lá por um motivo. Há uma pesquisa por trás do por que tais jogos não podem ser mostrados para esse público. Quanto mais nova a criança é, mais suscetível ela é ao efeito de mídias em geral, não só de jogos", diz Livia Scienza, doutora em psicologia pela Universidade Federal de São Carlos, que estuda o impacto de videogames no comportamento de crianças e adolescentes.

"Você é um ladrão no jogo, e isso é algo que não recomendamos para crianças e adolescentes", acrescenta a psiquiatra Danielle Admoni, especialista em infância e adolescência pela Universidade Federal de São Paulo (Unifesp).

GTA 6 acompanha uma dupla de criminosos, Jason Duval e Lucia Caminos , em uma aventura pelo mundo do crime no estado fictício de Leonida, inspirado na Flórida, nos Estados Unidos .

Nesta franquia, que existe desde 1997, o jogador pode atacar e matar criminosos, policiais e civis usando armas de fogo, facas, explosivos e outros objetos. Os ataques provocam sangramentos e podem formar poças de sangue ao redor dos corpos. Armas mais potentes também podem provocar decapitações e desmembramentos.

O jogador também pode ter relações sexuais, frequentar boates de strip-tease e tocar os seios das dançarinas. Em relação às drogas, é possível fumar maconha e consumir cocaína — ações que neste novo jogo afetam negativamente os relacionamentos entre os personagens ao longo da história.

Na maior parte dos países europeus, o jogo recebeu classificação indicativa para maiores de 18 anos, a mesma faixa etária adotada no Brasil. Nos Estados Unidos e no Canadá , a recomendação é para maiores de 17 anos.

Nos dois casos, a classificação é atribuída por sistemas de autorregulação criados pela própria indústria de games: o Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB), nos EUA e no Canadá, e o Pan European Game Information (PEGI), na Europa.

A diferença se dá porque, nos EUA e no Canadá, a classificação de 17 anos já permite conteúdos como violência intensa, sangue, mutilações, conteúdo sexual e linguagem forte. A restrição a adultos é reservada a jogos que apresentam, em geral, cenas prolongadas de violência intensa ou sexo e apostas com dinheiro real.

Grand Theft Auto 6 terá uma protagonista feminina pela primeira vez — Foto: Rockstar Games/Divulgação

Em famílias nas quais pais ou irmãos mais velhos também queiram jogar, mas não tenham privacidade para isso, a psiquiatra defende que é preciso estabelecer um diálogo para que as individualidades e necessidades de todos sejam respeitadas.

"A gente não tem relação sexual com a porta aberta, por exemplo. Como a gente faz? A gente se organiza. Neste caso, é o caso de jogar mais tarde, quando a criança estiver dormindo, ou quando ela não estiver em casa", diz Admoni.

"As pessoas têm filhos e querem que os filhos se adaptem a elas, mas não é assim que funciona. É o contrário: somos nós que temos que nos adaptar às crianças", acrescenta a psiquiatra.

Já quando a pressão vem de fora de casa — porque os colegas da escola só falam do jogo, e outras famílias não seguem a classificação indicativa —, Admoni diz que é preciso explicar à criança por que o conteúdo é inadequado e deixar claro que a restrição tem como objetivo protegê-la.

"A partir disso, você já está ensinando algo muito maior: regras e limites. Não se pode fazer tudo o que se quer. É melhor ser um pai chato e cuidadoso do que, lá na frente, ter que correr atrás de questões mentais. Se todo mundo está jogando, está todo mundo errado, e nosso papel é ensinar o que é correto", afirma Admoni.

O psiquiatra Guilherme Polanczyk, coordenador do Serviço de Psiquiatria da Infância e Adolescência do Instituto de Psiquiatria do Hospital das Clínicas de São Paulo, admite que impor limites às crianças e adolescentes pode ser desgastante, mas ressalta que isso faz parte da criação de um filho.

Ele pondera que, inevitavelmente, os filhos terão contato com o conteúdo do jogo, seja por meio de influenciadores digitais, seja por meio dos colegas da escola. Isso, porém, não é o mesmo que receber autorização dos pais para jogar, avalia.

"Muitos pais vão dizer que, de algum jeito, o filho já vai ser exposto ao conteúdo, então é melhor liberar. Mas tem uma diferença: se você não deixou, ele pode até estar vendo, mas sabe que é errado", afirma.

"Esses limites têm uma mensagem por trás: que a gente faz a coisa certa, que não tem espaço para o inadequado, que há coisas que são erradas e ponto final", acrescenta Polanczyk.

Admoni recorre a outro exemplo, bastante comum em muitas famílias, mas que, na avaliação dela, não deveria ser banalizado: crianças e adolescentes que fazem as refeições diante de aparelhos eletrônicos, como videogames portáteis, tablets e celulares , seja em casa, seja em restaurantes.

"Não é porque se tornou normal uma criança almoçar com iPad ou celular na frente que os seus filhos precisam fazer isso. Isso pode levar a uma série de problemas com alimentação no futuro", diz.

Os jogos influenciam crianças e adolescentes? O que diz a ciência

Os argumentos de quem defende uma postura menos restritiva por parte dos pais se apoiam em pesquisas que questionam a associação entre videogames violentos e comportamento agressivo na vida real.

Em 2019, pesquisadores das universidades de Oxford e Cardiff, na Inglaterra, publicaram na revista científica Royal Society Open Science um estudo com 1.004 adolescentes britânicos de 14 e 15 anos.

Os resultados não apontaram relação entre o envolvimento com jogos violentos e níveis mais elevados de comportamento agressivo.

Outra pesquisa, publicada em 2014 na revista BMC Psychiatry , baseada em entrevistas com crianças britânicas de 7 a 11 anos, identificou que a maioria era capaz de distinguir a violência retratada em videogames de situações reais.

Em linhas gerais, essas foram também as conclusões de Scienza ao estudar os possíveis efeitos dos jogos sobre crianças e adolescentes na UFSCar. Ela ressalta ainda que essa influência não se restringe aos videogames, podendo vir de qualquer outro tipo de mídia, como filmes , séries e desenhos animados .

"A literatura indica que crianças e adolescentes que já vivem em situação de vulnerabilidade são mais suscetíveis a esse tipo de influência. Quanto mais a criança vive em comunidades violentas, com exposição precoce ao sexo e às drogas, mais vulnerável ela é. Já aquelas que vivem em ambientes com mais diálogo e frequentam a escola são menos suscetíveis a esse tipo de influência", diz.

A psicóloga acrescenta que "o maior fator de proteção para crianças que jogam esse tipo de jogo é ter um responsável por perto, explicando que aquilo não é legal, que é fictício e que não deve ser feito na vida real".

"É importante também questionar por que a criança tomou determinada atitude naquela fase do jogo e, sempre que possível, jogar com ela", orienta Scienza.

A expectativa em torno do jogo tomou conta de locais em todo o mundo, incluindo a loja de departamentos Selfridges, em Londres — Foto: Getty Images via BBC

Há também quem argumente que o problema não está necessariamente nos jogos, mas em plataformas digitais como o Discord , onde podem circular conteúdos nocivos e os jovens podem ser incentivados a praticar atos de violência que vão de maus-tratos a animais a estupros.

Para Admoni, porém, a preocupação não deve se limitar à possibilidade de a criança se tornar mais ou menos violenta, mas abranger outros possíveis impactos sobre a saúde mental .

Ela afirma que, embora existam pesquisas que busquem identificar os efeitos da exposição de crianças e adolescentes a conteúdos violentos ou sexuais, ainda há incertezas sobre suas possíveis consequências.

Admoni ressalta que cada caso é particular e que fatores como o histórico de vida da criança, a forma como ocorreu a exposição e sua duração podem levar a resultados diferentes.

Com base em sua experiência clínica, porém, ela cita alguns possíveis prejuízos. "A gente tem visto quadros psicóticos, de transtornos obsessivos ou de estresse pós-traumático. E a exposição a longo prazo tem alterações até nas características de relacionamento: elas vão se tornando mais frias."

Polanczyk, do Hospital das Clínicas, acrescenta que "ter exposição a esses conteúdos, principalmente por muitos dias, muitas horas, vai moldando a visão" das crianças e adolescentes.

"Eventualmente, eles reproduzem na vida real aqueles padrões de relacionamento que estão vivendo nos jogos. Muitas vezes, são adolescentes que já têm um componente de agressividade, irritabilidade, podem ter sintomas depressivos, e quando expostos a esse conteúdo o efeito pode ser muito danoso", ele avalia.

GTA 6 terá dois protagonistas inéditos, Jason e Lucia — a primeira personagem feminina jogável de toda a série de jogos em 3D — Foto: Rockstar Games/Divulgação

Há ainda quem argumente que os jogos podem produzir efeitos positivos, ao mostrar que determinadas atitudes consideradas inadequadas têm consequências.

Existe, aliás, a expectativa de que GTA 6 siga uma tendência observada em outros títulos recentes e incentive o jogador a adotar comportamentos positivos.

Em Red Dead Redemption 2 , outro sucesso da indústria, a maneira como o jogador interage com o ambiente e os personagens influencia um sistema de honra associado ao protagonista.

Segundo a desenvolvedora do título, a Rockstar Games, mesma empresa por trás de GTA , ajudar pessoas em perigo, poupar adversários e agir com generosidade aumentam a honra, ao mesmo tempo em que roubar ou prejudicar pessoas inocentes reduzem a honra.

Dependendo de suas escolhas, portanto, o jogador pode ser tratado de maneira diferente pelos demais personagens, que não podem ser controlados pelo jogador. Atitudes negativas, por exemplo, podem dificultar a resolução de conflitos ao longo da história.

"O crime é uma parte fundamental de GTA . Estamos tentando garantir que não punamos os jogadores por jogarem da maneira a que estão acostumados, mas suas ações terão algum efeito sobre o desenrolar do jogo", afirmou Rob Nelson, codiretor do estúdio Rockstar North, em entrevista ao jornal britânico The Guardian.

Questionado se GTA 6 seria o primeiro título da franquia a tentar incentivar algum grau de empatia nos jogadores, Nelson respondeu afirmativamente. "Pela primeira vez, tentamos oferecer mecanismos que incentivem isso, para aqueles que quiserem."

De todo modo, avalia a psiquiatra, não é necessário expor uma criança a um jogo violento para ensiná-la o que não deve fazer na vida real. "Você não precisa expor a criança. Não precisa jogar ela no meio da rua para ensiná-la que ela precisa olhar para os dois lados antes de atravessar", afirma.

articles.title: GTA VI: Lançamento deve render R$ 11,5 bilhões no primeiro dia | G1
articles.standfirst: Com custo de produção estimado em pelo menos US$ 1 bilhão (R$ 5,75 bilhões), jogo impulsiona ações da Take-Two Interactive enquanto investidores aguardam versão para PC e modo online em 2027.
articles.summary: Com produção de US$ 1 bilhão, o lançamento de GTA VI deve render R$ 11,5 bilhões no primeiro dia, superando recordes da Take-Two Interactive e do antecessor GTA V.
articles.body:
A aventura da dupla de criminosos Lucia e Jason por Vice City em "GTA VI" deve ajudar a Take-Two Interactive a arrecadar cerca de US$ 2 bilhões (R$ 11,5 bilhões, na cotação atual) em vendas estimadas no primeiro dia de lançamento do game.

A Take-Two Interactive, empresa controladora da Rockstar Games, desenvolvedora do "GTA", não é um nome muito conhecido, apesar de seu portfólio de grandes sucessos, incluindo a franquia "Red Dead Redemption" e a série de basquete "NBA 2K".

A empresa de análise Sensor Tower estima que o total de unidades vendidas do videogame até a manhã desta quinta-feira (19) seja de 19,1 milhões, o que se traduz em cerca de US$ 1,84 bilhão (R$ 10,58 bilhões) em receita para a Take-Two. Esse valor é mais do que o dobro dos cerca de US$ 800 milhões (R$ 4,6 bilhões) em cópias vendidas por "GTA V" em seu primeiro dia em 2013.

'GTA VI' estará disponível no Brasil a partir desta quinta-feira (19) — Foto: Reuters

Enquanto isso, a Take-Two tem se mantido discreta sobre a demanda por "GTA VI" desde que a pré-venda foi aberta em junho, limitando-se a comentar que a procura tem sido "sem precedentes" ou "muito acima das expectativas".

"O título é tão aguardado que os consumidores parecem muito, muito animados, e toda a cobertura da imprensa até agora tem sido universalmente positiva, mas ainda não estamos prontos para declarar vitória", disse o presidente-executivo, Strauss Zelnick, na conferência sobre os resultados financeiros da Take-Two no início deste mês.

"Temos o costume de evitar declarar sucesso antes que ele aconteça", completou o executivo.

Propaganda do jogo 'GTA VI' pelas ruas dos EUA — Foto: Reuters

A Take-Two gastou cerca de US$ 1 bilhão (R$ 5,75 bilhões) ou mais em custos de produção do "GTA VI", tornando-o um dos projetos de entretenimento mais caros já produzidos.

A Sensor Tower estima que o trailer promocional do jogo, o "Extended Look" do "GTA VI", exibido na Netflix em agosto, ajudou a impulsionar um aumento de seis vezes nas pré-vendas.

Em Miami, cidade que serviu de inspiração para Vice City, o time local da NBA comemorou o lançamento na quarta-feira (18) com uma partida temática inspirada no universo do game.

No fim de semana, a empresa vai promover o "GTA VI: The Festival", um festival musical com elenco repleto de estrelas que inclui a rapper vencedora do Grammy Cardi B, o produtor de hip-hop Metro Boomin e Travis Scott.

'GTA VI' chegou ao Brasil nesta quinta-feira (19) — Foto: Reuters

Os investidores aguardam notícias da Take-Two sobre seus planos para o lançamento de "GTA VI" para PCs e a disponibilização de uma versão online. O componente online e multijogador de um videogame é crucial para transformar o título em uma fonte de receita recorrente.

Alguns analistas do setor esperam o lançamento para PC e o modo online em 2027.

A corretora TD Cowen nomeou a Take-Two como uma de suas "Melhores Ideias" para 2027, e o analista Doug Creutz se mostrou otimista quanto às perspectivas financeiras da empresa quando a versão online do jogo for lançada.

"O teto potencial para o desempenho de longo prazo dos gastos recorrentes dos consumidores com o 'GTA VI' é muito alto... 'quando' e 'qual será a magnitude' do próximo 'GTA Online' são as questões mais importantes para as ações, mais do que as vendas unitárias do 'GTA VI'", avaliou.

articles.title: Buck Me Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: In Grand Theft Auto VI's Buck Me mission, Lucia needs a bank account to get paid for her community service work, and Jason doesn’t have one.
articles.body:
In Grand Theft Auto VI 's Buck Me mission, Lucia needs a bank account to get paid for her community service work, and Jason doesn’t have one. He’s asked to join Lucia at the local Fleeca bank to set one up. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through what goes down in the Chapter 1 main mission, Buck Me, including which option to pick inside the bank.

Lucia needs a bank account to get her community service payments. Meet her at the Fleeca nearby.

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

Enter the Fleeca building when you’re ready to start the Buck Me main mission. If you arrive at the bank in the evening after it’s closed, approach the door anyway and time skips to 9:15 AM so that you can get started. Jason texts Lucia to meet and open the bank account. She’ll meet you there soon.

Inside, focus on the bank teller with L2 / LT and ask her about getting an account set up. She’ll tell you to go to the right and speak with the manager, a man in blue shirt. Talk to him and he walks Jason into the back office to begin. You can sit or stay standing until a cutscene begins.

The bank manager has a look of general concern as Jason describes being discharged and when he mentions Lucia just got out of prison. When Lucia arrives and sits down, she asks for a loan too. The manager asks if they have any money to deposit. You have two options here:

Saved Cash – You can have Jason mention his saved cash, which boosts his relationship with Lucia.

Say Nothing – If you choose Say Nothing, the relationship is negatively impacted. It doesn’t change the outcome of getting an account set up.

The manager goes on to tell Jason and Lucia they have horrible credit and can’t get an account or a mortgage. All they can get is BuckMe, which Lucia isn’t happy about. The scene cuts forward to Lucia and Jason back at home. Jason suggests starting a joint savings account for Tomas, which Lucia agrees to.

When you’ve got control, press D-pad Up to bring up your phone. Scroll down to the BuckMe app and open it. After the… interesting introduction video, select the checking account, then “Buck Yourself.” Select “Buck Yourself” again to move the $100 in the checking account to the Family Savings. After this, you can sit with Lucia on the couch or move on to something else.

BuckMe is used for all sorts of payments around Leonida. You need to deposit more into Jason’s account to not only be able to use it for other payments, but to contribute to the Family Savings.

Use the map index or BuckMe to find nearby ATMs. Make a cash deposit into your BuckMe checking account at an ATM.

Selecting the ATM Finder in the BuckMe app marks the nearest ATM as your waypoint. The one closest to Jason’s house is at Chuck’s Tackle & Shot, the shop where the Kingfishers tried to jump Jason.

Head over when you’re ready and interact with the ATM outside the shop to deposit money into Jason’s account. You can take some or all of the money in Jason’s stash for BuckMe.

You can see how much money Jason has in his account at any time by opening the BuckMe app, or better yet, pressing D-pad Down on the D-Pad and looking at the top right of the screen.

There, you’ll see the BuckMe total and the cash Jason has on hand.

Save for the Future is a main mission that lingers. Your goal for now is to get $5,000 into the account. Remember, once you deposit money into Family Savings, it cannot be recovered.

Not long after the deposit, Brian texts Jason, asking Jason to meet him at the marina . You don’t have a timer on this one, so feel free to explore and earn money with side activities until you’re ready.

Need help making more money? Here are a few activities to help with that:

By now, you’ve received a heads up from Cal that there are four more lost packages of drugs out in Mariana County, prompting the Optional Mission , Find the Lost Drugs .

Hit Illegal Operations – Kingfishers already don’t like you, so it won’t hurt to antagonize them more by robbing their base out in Wetman Bay.

Read the Best Ways to Make Money Early guide for more ideas on getting to $5K.

articles.title: Down to Earth Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: After completing the Buck Me mission in Grand Theft Auto VI, Brian texts Jason unexpectedly for a meeting. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through how
articles.body:
After completing the Buck Me mission in Grand Theft Auto VI , Brian texts Jason unexpectedly for a meeting. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through how to complete Brian’s latest job for Jason in the Chapter 1 main mission, Down to Earth.

Brian wants you at the marina. Head over and find out what he needs.

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

Go to Brian’s Marina to start the Down to Earth main mission. As you walk into the building, you’ll spot Cal out front. You can ask him for Brian’s location or just walk past him and head in and up to the office. Inside, you’ll find Brian at his desk working on a laptop.

Brian has secured a new broker. You’re tasked with picking up a package from a contact then making three deliveries. Donnie work, but without Donnie. Follow Brian out of the office as he talks more about issues he’s had with Donnie. Before you can go, you need to help Cal pressure wash the boat parked right out front. Pick up the pressure washer, then hold L2 + R2 / LT + RT to clean the boat. Once you’ve cleared the mess enough, a short scene plays and Lucia arrives. Finish cleaning the new spot on the boat.

When it’s done, Brian returns, meets Lucia, and gives Jason the all-clear for takeoff. Lucia wants to join, and Jason can’t say no. Go to the plane with Lucia.

Your first destination is far to the northwest. It’s likely been a bit since you were last in the air with Donnie, so here are a few essential inputs and things to keep in mind while flying:

Hold R2 / RT to move. Once you get enough speed, pull down on the left thumbstick ( Left Stick ) to take off (or up if you’re playing inverted).

Use Square / X to yaw (turn) left, and Circle / B to yaw (turn) right.

Press D-pad Down on the D-Pad to see the location of your target marked with a pink arrow.

For now, you can fly as high as you’d like without repercussions. That won’t last forever, so enjoy it while you can. Once you get close to Bobcat Bay, you’re instructed to press Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click / Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click to enter Focus Mode and find the ship before landing.

Slow down as you approach and land close to the ship. A cutscene corrects your position if you landed facing away from the ship. Catch the cocaine as Lucia pulls up to it with Triangle / Y . It all seems to be going well until suddenly, it’s not.

This shootout gives you an exciting new upgrade to Focus Mode called Combat Focus. Now when you’re in combat or have a weapon equipped, press Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click /+ Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click to slow down time and not only see enemy locations, but their weak points too. Red spots are kill shots, while yellow spots will incapacitate your enemies.

Your aggression in combat impacts your Criminal Profile rating. In some shootouts, you don’t have much of a choice other than relying on extreme violence. However, if you are playing with the intention of maintaining a professional profile for Jason and Lucia, try to incapacitate when things aren’t as hectic rather than going straight for headshots.

Now that you’ve got the package and are in relative safety, it’s time to deliver the three packages. The drops are neatly in a line across the map with an obvious spot to the east to visit first. This section gives you a great chance to practice landing in a targeted area. Be sure to slow on your approach and land evenly with the water. Once you land, Lucia leans out of the plane and throws the package. Take off again and do the second drop.

As you fly away from the second, Lucia and Jason hear an alert from the coast guard about their odd landing pattern. For the third and final drop, you’ll only need to fly low over the boat for Lucia to make the drop.

The drops are done and just in time for Jason to rush them both home. Hold D-pad Down on the D-Pad and hover over the house icon to easily mark it as your next destination, then fly over.

Once again, ease on the speed as you near the house and land close to Jason’s dock. One short and panicked landing cutscene later, run out the back door and down the stairs to the shed under the house to store the narcotics.

Inside, walk to the back and store the extra cocaine quickly in the washing machine. Meanwhile, Lucia is talking to her parole officer, Joe, trying to explain her absence. Join Lucia by the front stairs to support her in talking to the officer.

Listen as Lucia and Jason explain what happened to the office. The scene morphs into a proper cutscene where Lucia is let off with a warning this time. The two return home, ending the day. The next morning, Brian sends Jason a payment for the job over BuckMe for $500 .

Wander into the kitchen to have a rather serious talk with Lucia that provides more opportunity for relationship growth. After the chat, Lucia invites Jason outside for a quick meditation. Follow her to do it and unlock a new type of collectible: Meditation Spots . You’ve technically completed the mission, but the duffle bag of cocaine is still stored in Jason’s dryer. Grab it when you have time and sell it to Donnie to make an additional $800 .

Up next is a mission you’ll unlock a short time later after Donnie calls, saying Brian has another big job for them both. When you’re ready, it’s time to take on the next main mission, Clear Skies .

Taking a break from the main missions ? Use these helpful guides for your next adventure:

articles.title: Pipework Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: After you’ve completed Lab Fees in Grand Theft Auto VI, Brian calls and asks Jason to collect Mandy’s rent, something he knows Jason isn’t
articles.body:
After you’ve completed Lab Fees in Grand Theft Auto VI , Brian calls and asks Jason to collect Mandy’s rent, something he knows Jason isn’t going to want to do. This official IGN GTA 6 walks you through everything you can do with Jason’s neighbor, Mandy, in the Chapter 1 mission Pipework.

Another one of Brian’s tenants owes him rent. Head over to Mandy’s to collect.

The Pipework main mission begins when you pull up to Mandy’s home, a blue house just down the street from Jason’s. Mandy is outside arguing with her next-door neighbor.

Mandy says she won’t pay rent until her kitchen sink gets fixed – flirtatiously, somehow. Follow her into the house. She asks you to accompany her to the bedroom to get her laptop to pay her rent. Of course.

You’re forced into her doorway as she grabs the laptop. You can listen to her talk about her life, or you can hold L2 / LT and interrupt by asking for her plunger. If you don’t interrupt, she’ll tease you for following her to the bedroom and tell you where the plunger is anyway. Surprise, it’s in her bathroom across the hall.

After the conversation, you can enter Mandy’s room and look around, though there aren’t any items to interact with. If you focus on Mandy, you can talk to her a little more, but she’ll eventually tell you to go fix the sink.

There’s a door in between the bathroom and her bedroom you can enter that leads to Mandy’s office. Enter, and you’ll find a funny thing to interact with. After you do, you can ask Mandy about it before getting to work.

Grab the plunger from the bathroom and take it to the kitchen. With the plunger in hand, approach the sink and press Triangle / Y . Press Right Stick Click / Right Stick Click multiple times until the sink begins to bubble and Jason steps back as gunk spews into the sink.

Jason takes a look at the pipework. Something is clearly stuck in the drain. Hold R2 / RT to use the wrench. Mandy emerges from her room after the first time you use the wrench wearing next to nothing, clearly coming onto Jason. Get back to using the wrench when the prompt reappears.

Continue using the wrench as Jason and Mandy talk. The pipe comes loose, and Jason catches the strange thing that was clogging the pipe. Mandy runs up, grabs it, and takes it away before Jason gets a clear look at it.

Jason reattaches the pipe and moves out from under the sink automatically, leading to a cutscene where Mandy returns and offers Jason cigars – only to snap the box shut. She angrily asks why Jason isn’t interested in her. You can interrupt her interrogation or let the scene play out as she asks about Lucia.

A crash out front interrupts the argument and Mandy runs out of the house. You can stay and look around more if you’d like, but there isn’t anything to collect unless you want to eat one of her apples. Exit the house and Jason walks forward on his own toward Mandy as she calls out to her neighbor Bert. She’ll throw the Macizo Cigars across the front lawn in anger. They’re still good, though, so don’t forget to pick them up from wherever they landed .

You can go back into Mandy’s house and calm her down if you want, or you can leave and call the mission done. Brian texts not long after leaving the house confirming he received her rent.

Depending on what you've completed, these main missions may be available for you next:

You can also drive around the Keys and see other parts of Leonida! Just be aware that as you drive, you’ll use gas that’ll cost you money to refill. There’s a $5 toll bridge for leaving and reentering the Keys, too. Learn more about exploring early on with our Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , or take a look at the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks .

articles.title: Island Dreams Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Jason has an opportunity to make money treasure hunting with one of Brian’s friends, Kenton Rees. In Grand Theft Auto VI’s Chapter 1 main
articles.body:
Jason has an opportunity to make money treasure hunting with one of Brian’s friends, Kenton Rees. In Grand Theft Auto VI ’s Chapter 1 main mission, Island Dreams, you’ll unlock new tools and gain access to a unique side activity. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through Island Dreams, including how to find all three treasure locations.

Kenton, the treasure hunter you met at Brian’s, has work available. Drop by his place in Key Lento.

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

Kenton’s shop is on the northeast side of Key Lento. Head over when you’re ready to get to work. The shop, Island Dreams, is a yellow shop on the corner of the short pier.

As you walk down the dock to the shop, stop at the end of the walkway before turning right toward the shop door and look at the barrel behind the black tank in the shadows, shown below. You’ll spot what may be your first collectible, a collectible card from the Los Santos Panic basketball card set - Marquise Bernard , to be exact. Keep an eye out for these throughout Leonida.

You can view all the cards you’ve collected in the Progress menu under the Collections section. You can also keep track of all the cards you found and discover the locations of the ones you’re missing with our Collectible Cards Locations guide .

Enter Island Dreams to start a cutscene with Kenton. He tells Jason about the diving business and a little about his adversary, Sir Todd Bancroft. The scene cuts to the ship where a bachelor party climbs aboard for a diving trip that’ll act as cover for the real mission: treasure hunting.

The cutscene leads to Jason boarding Kenton’s ship, the Sea Enchantress. The diving spot you need to get to is .95 mi away. The drive is a mostly a straight shot, giving you time to look at what’s happening in the back of the ship with Kenton and the bachelor party by pressing Right Stick Click / Right Stick Click . Kenton eventually comes up and gives Jason a quick brief of the mission.

Upon reaching the target destination the boat slows automatically. Kenton prepares the bachelor party, then you’re instructed to pick up and put on the scuba gear sitting on the ship seat. Kenton hands Jason two important new pieces of equipment: a metal detector and an Arras Bullhead spear gun, which you can use to defend yourself against threats when diving. With them stored, you can hop into the water and begin the dive.

Escort the Bachelor Party Through the Trench

The three members of the bachelor party excitedly chat about the tour as you enter the water. Rather than leading, you’ll follow the party through the trench and keep focused on your mission.

Ascend toward the surface using Cross / A

Swim faster by pressing Left Stick Click / Left Stick Click while underwater

Swim backwards or strafe by holding L2 / LT

As you explore Leonida, you’ll come across all sorts of animals. This underwater mission offers a great opportunity to study various sea creatures. Doing so adds information about them to your collection. To study an animal, press and hold L2 / LT to Focus and when you’re close enough to an unidentified creature, press and hold R1 / RB . You can view all animals you’ve studied so far in the Progress menu under the Animals section.

The trench opens to the dive site, your first Underwater Discovery, Nuestra Senora del Ocio. Jason tells the guys to go explore while he does something else. Equip the metal detector with the loadout menu by holding L1 / LB and selecting the yellow device. With it in hand, hold L2 / LT or R2 / RT to find a signal.

When you’re close enough to a piece of treasure, a small yellow treasure chest will appear, marking the item’s location. Swim to it and press Triangle / Y to dig it up. While searching, you’ll need to press Cross / A rapidly to dig. There are three treasures to find in this first area, marked in the screenshot below:

The first treasure is in the sand by the sea turtle.

The next is north of the first one, on a short ridge.

The third and final treasure is near the broken pots by the wood debris.

The amount of money you make from this mission isn’t dependent on the number of doubloons you dig up. You can return to this shipwreck later if you miss anything.

Comms get lively after you’ve collected the second piece of treasure. Dobbs’ mic dies and the other two party members panic. Quickly grab the third treasure if you haven’t already (again, you can come back later for it) and swim over to the sunken ship. Dobbs managed to get himself stuck in a metal grate. Approach and pull him out by holding L2 + R2 / LT + RT and then mash Cross / A to lift. After you’ve freed Dobbs, the old grate falls into the ship. If you dive into the new hole you’ll find one more piece of treasure, bringing the total possible to find during this mission to four.

Dobbs is bleeding. It’s time to go. Swim back toward the ship with the group, and while you’re at it, equip the Arras Bullhead longarm (the harpoon) from your loadout. A shark approaches from the direction of the ship, and it’s up to you if you want to save Dobbs or not. To save him, you’ll need to shoot the shark before it closes in for its attack. Punching it won’t work.

Should You Save Dobbs From the Shark? All Outcomes 🦈

Before Kenton can drive the ship and its passengers back to shore, his nemesis Todd drifts in to snoop. The cutscene ends with Jason leaving Island Dreams. You’ll get $400 for your work regardless of how many gold doubloons you found and Dobbs’ fate. The mission ends, allowing you to go wherever you want next.

A few in-game hours after you’ve completed the mission, Kenton calls and asks you to do more dives. Kenton’s shop is added to your map under the Exploration section. Now, whenever you want to do some diving, you can visit Kenton to borrow his boat and gear or just stop by to turn in what you’ve discovered. You’ll also find diving gear on Jason’s boat. Kenton follows up the call with a text including three shipwreck locations.

articles.summary: In Grand Theft Auto VI's Day Release main mission, Jason and Lucia get a break from their normal life when Mattia and Kat invite them for a while night
articles.body:
In Grand Theft Auto VI ' s Day Release main mission, Jason and Lucia get a break from their normal life when Mattia and Kat invite them for a while night out in Vice City. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through the Chapter 1 mission, Day Release.

Kat and Mattia want to hang out with you and Lucia. Meet them at The Rusty Anchor.

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

Visit The Rusty Anchor and order a drink at the bar to start the Day Release main mission in GTA VI. The drink you choose is free! Lucia arrives shortly after and the two get changed for the boat trip. The cutscene shifts to Mattia arriving with a guy who removes her ankle monitor.

When Mattia greets you, he offers you his hand; you can decide whether or not to shake it with R2 / RT . It's totally up to you: shake hands if you like, but if you decline, he doesn't mind, and nothing changes.

With her ankle monitor off, you get your first chance to play as Lucia. Follow Mattia to the speedboat. Lucia promptly hops into the divers seat, giving you the chance to take a spin with the fanciest boat you’ve been in yet. Drive northeast toward the first marker .80 mi away.

After you reach it and Mattia attempts to take his video, the marker moves 3.76 mi north to spot in the Atlantic where you’ll find the yacht. As you drive, Lucia and Jason talk with Mattia about his work and life.

A cutscene of the four kicking off their party starts as you pull up to the back of the yacht. Not long after, you’re hopping onto a jet ski with or without Jason.

Drive around following Mattia. You can practice jumps in the water, though nothing changes if you do take them. As the ride comes to an end, Mattia challenges Lucia and Jason a casual race back to the yacht. Don’t forget to press Cross / A to slow down fast and take sharp turns.

Back on the yacht, you’ll shoot champagne bottles using Combat Focus ( Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click / Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click ) before Mattia cracks open “the good stuff” as the cutscene continues.

Kat eventually takes Lucia downstairs where she can wear one of three dresses: a brown dress, a gold dress, or a black dress. There is no correct choice (except the gold one because it looks best with Lucia’s shoes and it’s sick), but whatever you choose is what Lucia wears for the rest of the night.

After getting changed, Lucia wants to find Mattia. Walk downstairs. This is another sort of mission objective where you can explore and listen to strange conversations from random guests and engage in short, unique activities.

If you ask folks about where Mattia went, most will say they saw him go downstairs. Take some time to explore the interactable spots on the middle deck before you do. If you use Focus Mode, you can quickly see the people you can interact with.

As you walk toward the front of the ship on the middle level, walk on the east side (or at least make a point to go over there at some point) and talk to the two standing by the railing leading downstairs. They’ll give Lucia a free pair of expensive sunglasses.

When you’re ready to find Mattia, go down to the lower level and enter the main room. You’ll spot Mattia preparing lines of cocaine for himself and other party guests. Approaching him kicks off the next scene: a luxury drive in Vice City.

The scene shifts and you’re suddenly in a Granforma Zorrusso. The supercar is fast and handles great. If you crash and total the car or if you lose Mattia on the way to the first stop, you’ll restart at the last checkpoint.

Take Exit 1 when Mattia calls for it, continuing to follow until you’re pulled into a brief scene of Mattia picking up more cocaine. After, Mattia challenges Lucia to race to the club.

It’s tough since there’s still traffic (don’t forget to use Cross / A to slide around the left turn!), but there aren’t any repercussions if you lose. Your money is safe from the top shelf – for now.

When you arrive at the club another cutscene plays before you can walk in with Jason. You can choose to hold his hand as you follow Mattia through the winding hall of the club. At the table, you’re given a quick choice to take the drugs offered or pass. If you accept them, Jason will too and the pulsing lights continue. If you don’t, things settle a tad visually but nothing drastically changes.

After, Lucia and Jason go to dance. Don’t forget to add flair by pressing Square / X !

The debauchery continues. Eventually the party ends up at a hotel. A drunk Lucia leaves for the bathroom and exits to see strangers. Walk down the hotel hallway and enter rooms to see a menagerie of lewd scenes. You can also go straight down the hall to the end if you want to skip them.

If you choose to explore you’ll be turned around several times after you close the door of the room you were last in.

The night ends shortly after Lucia returns to the hotel. Mattia finally talks about business with the pair, offering a job Lucia excitedly accepts. Mattia will reach out with more details later. Back in Key Lento, the two return to their normal lives.

You’re back as Jason, while Lucia, equipped with her ankle monitor, goes to work. With coffee in hand, Jason receives an angry call from Brian who asks him to get to the Marina leading to the next mission, Swamped .

Save $590 off Acer Nitro 65 RX 9060 XT (16GB) Gaming PC

Acer Nitro 65 AMD Ryzen 7 8700F Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB Gaming PC (16GB/1TB)

The Acer Nitro 65 is equipped with an air-cooled AMD Ryzen 7 8700F CPU, Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB NVMe SSD. The AMD Ryzen 7 8700F CPU is an 8-core, 16 thread processor with a max boost clock of 5GHz. It's a good CPU for gaming because of its high clock speed. It only has eight cores, but that's plenty for games since very few titles can benefit from more than eight or even six cores.

The Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB GPU is an excellent card for 1080p gaming

The Radeon RX 9060 XT graphics card comes in two variants, with the only difference between the two being the amount of VRAM: 8GB or 16GB. Unlike the vast majority of prebuilts which are equipped with the 8GB model, this particular system is equipped with the 16GB model. If you can afford it, you should only get the 16GB model. Numerous outlets ( including our own ) have demonstrated that the performance gap between the 8GB and 16GB models is significant.

The Radeon RX 9060 XT is an excellent GPU for 1080p gaming. It performs within range of the GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB. The 16GB of VRAM also allows this GPU to hold its own in 1440p gaming, especially if you don't want to spend the extra hundreds of dollars more to upgrade to a more powerful card like the RX 9070 XT.

This system is more powerful than the Steam Machine for about the same price

The AMD Ryzen 7 8700F CPU and Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB CPU combo significantly outclasses the $1,049 Steam Machine , which is equipped with a very low wattage CPU and a custom GPU equivalent to the Radeon RX 7600 or GeForce RTX 4060. The Steam Machine runs off Steam OS instead of Windows. If you prefer Steam OS, IGN's Jackie Thomas demonstrates that you can pretty easily install it on an AMD-based PC like this one .

articles.title: Just Eat Reveals Gaming Controller With an Extra Button Just for Ordering Food
articles.summary: Just Eat is giving away a controller with a button dedicated to ordering food.
articles.body:
Just Eat is giving away a controller with a button dedicated to ordering food.

The 'Stay in the Game' controller features what the food delivery company is calling a 'ChEAT' button under the standard diamond of action buttons. The limited-edition controller is only available through local giveaways in the U.K., and Just Eat has partnered with two local Twitch streamers for the promotion.

"When you’re deep into a high-stakes gaming session, nothing kills the moment faster than having to pause the action just to sort out food," said Tina Koehler, Just Eat's UK&I marketing director. "Just Eat has unlocked the ultimate hack to evade the kitchen, enabling gamers to stay just where they are and locked into play."

The company’s official UK accounts shared an AI-generated rendering of the controller, shown above, with the orange Just Eat feature on an otherwise very familiar looking peripheral. While the announcement doesn't offer any real information about the controller’s design or compatibility, it certainly looks quite a bit like PlayStation's standard DualSense.

Social media has plenty of thoughts about the reveal. While some users think the rendered controller looks surprisingly decent, with one claiming the grips "look better than a stock PS5 controller," others were quick to notice the button’s placement is, well, a little dangerous.

We don’t know how exactly the button works, but it most likely opens an external link to the Just Eat app or website. If it really did let you order food with the literal hit of a button, a couple slip-ups during a GTA car chase could lead to a pile of chicken nuggets at your door and a big dent in your wallet.

Fast Food Creations Inspired by Video Games

We’ll likely learn more when UK-based streamers Angry Ginge and Danny Aarons show off the new controller on Twitch. The two streamers are also how you’ll get your chance to use the controller yourself, as they’ll be sharing giveaway information across their social media accounts. Winners receive the limited-edition controller in addition to £300 in Just Eat credit.

The controller reveal coincides with the launch of GTA 6 , as plenty of companies toy with the 'concern' that gamers won’t be able to take their eyes away from Leonida. Just this week, McDonald’s launched its own direct order app in Discord .

The majority of brands, however, have embraced the hype. Popeye’s just launched its own Vice City sandwich , and happens to be a major participant in however this Just Eat controller ends up working.

articles.title: Crunchyroll Launches Official Black Friday Deal With Up to 60% Off All Subscription Tiers
articles.body:
Crunchyroll has officially unveiled its Black Friday deals for 2026 . From now until November 30, both new and select returning subscribers can save on six months of any Crunchyroll subscription.

The anime streaming service is offering discounts on all three of its ad-free plans, offering between 50% and 60% in monthly savings. Fan plans have dropped from $8.99 to $3.99/month, Mega Fan has dropped from $13.99 to $5.99/month, and the Ultimate Fan tier has dropped from $17.99 to $8.99/month.

Crunchyroll has made a number of changes to its subscription model over the past year, with a big emphasis on the brand’s features outside of streaming. Read on for a breakdown of what’s currently included in each plan.

Crunchyroll Black Friday Deals - Each Tier Explained

The big shift in Crunchyroll’s streaming set-up started when the service removed its free streaming tier at the end of last year. Soon after, the service increased prices while moving some features and benefits around to try and justify the hike.

If you’re in it for the streaming, no plan has ads and every plan gets simulcasts . Otherwise, here’s how things stand now:

Crunchyroll Fan basically gets you the Crunchyroll anime library. You get limited offline downloads and can only stream on one device at a time.

Crunchyroll Mega Fan ups your simultaneous streaming limit to four devices and opens up Crunchyroll’s Game Vault, which offers over 100 anime-adjacent games. You also get access to the Crunchyroll Store with free shipping on orders over $50. Yes, store access is now restricted to the most expensive subscriptions.

For reference, the entire Crunchyroll Store is now operating with a 'limited drop' model attached to specific licenses, like a recent Chainsaw Man collab .

Crunchyroll Chainsaw Man Drop August 2026

Finally, the most expensive Crunchyroll Ultimate Fan tier lets you stream all the anime on up to six devices and tacks in access to Crunchyroll Manga, a relatively new service .

The rest of the perks are all about the Store, where you’ll get early access to drops and free shipping on every order. You also get a swag bag if you subscribe for 12 consecutive months, which, unfortunately, this deal won’t cover.

Note that the deal seemingly removes the option for Crunchyroll’s usual seven-day free trial . If you want to get a better sense of the service before paying up, Crunchyroll is still kind enough to let you at least see its libraries without a subscription. I’d recommend scrolling through the full list of anime , manga , and games before making a decision.

We’re Keeping Tracking of the Best Black Friday Deals

Black Friday has basically already started, at least according to Amazon . Paramount+ is the only other major service that's announced its annual discounts so far, but I expect plenty more streaming deals to come down the pipeline.

articles.body:
Lanterns star Aaron Pierre had already reprised his role as Green Lantern John Stewart for the 2027 film Man of Tomorrow when the news broke that DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran had been fired by new parent company Skydance. Whether his appearance will remain in the final film now that there’s a new regime in charge of DC, Pierre says, “I’m very at peace. What will be will be.”

In a podcast chat with IndieWire recorded the same day the news about Gunn and Safran broke, Pierre says, “Well, I actually only just found out the news prior to logging on so I haven’t very much time at all to process the enormity of that news. But what I can say is that my relationship with James and my relationship with Peter is a beautiful relationship and I’ve really loved every moment collaborating with them and working with them and getting to know them. And I’m excited to, beyond this point, in a different context, collaborate with them again and I’m also excited to see what happens next for DC.”

The Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow was in post-production when Gunn and Safran were removed from their posts. It didn’t take long for the online rumor mill to flood the internet with claims that Skydance was going to remove many of the cameos from Man of Tomorrow, namely Supergirl and Blue Beetle . John Stewart is among the DC heroes set to appear in the film.

Gunn, though, shot down all such claims of studio meddling , stating that no one at Skydance has even seen the film yet. "There are a lot of untrue rumors going around, but one of them is that Skydance has seen Man of Tomorrow and that all sorts of sweeping changes are being made," Gunn posted. "No one from Skydance has even seen the movie - the only people that have are Peter Safran and a very small trusted group of friends and family. So any stories around this narrative are false."

It remains unclear what DC Studios’ future looks like until Jeremy Latcham , the incoming President and Chief Creative Officer of DC Studios, takes his post on December 1. For his part, Pierre is remaining zen about what’s in store for Man of Tomorrow and DC’s future. (The status of Lanterns Season 2 also remains up in the air .)

DC Universe: Every Upcoming Movie and TV Show

“I think for me, you know, we did the film and we really loved every moment of doing the film and what happens beyond this point is not my decision. So I’m very at peace,” Pierre tells IndieWire.

“What will be will be. But what I do know is that those friendships will last beyond this point and also those artistic creative, working collaboration relationships will live beyond this point as well. And as I say, I’m excited to see where DC goes from here.”

Until Latcham says otherwise, fans can only suspect things are back to square one again lest they heed some fans’ advice not to reboot the DCU again . If that’s it for Gunn and Safran’s “Gods and Monsters” saga then why should fans be invested in Man of Tomorrow if it no longer matters ? It will likely just collapse at the box office like The Flash did after Gunn ended the DCEU.

Jim Vejvoda (he/him) is IGN's Assoc. Director of Entertainment Content.

articles.body:
During Chapter 1 , you are given optional tasks that can boost Jason and Lucia's relationship when completed. Some of these tasks involve making improvements to Jason's home, which has several unfinished or old areas that could use repair. To fix these, you’ll need to approach the various materials around the house and interact with them. Not all of these tasks are easy to find, and can be easily missed if you don't know where to look. This official IGN GTA 6 guide details exactly where to find all home repairs, including the steps , leaky roof , railing , and more.

Note : Fixing up the house does not need to be completed before picking up Lucia. You can make repairs even after she's back at home.

How to Find and Fix the Railing in GTA 6

To find the railing at Jason's home, head out onto the back porch and down the stairs to the gym setup . Next to the silver ladder is a broken portion of the porch railing that you can interact with and fix by holding Triangle / Y .

Do note that you can only fix the railing when approaching it from the gym side. Trying to fix the railing from the upper deck side that's closest to the back door won't work. To finish the job, simply press R2 / RT to nail the remaining rails.

The wood for this repair is right next to the front steps leading to the front door.

How to Find and Fix the Leaky Roof in GTA 6

Begin this repair by climbing the yellow ladder next to the front door to the roof and interacting with the blue tarp area.

How to Fix and Paints the Walls in GTA 6
