articles.summary: During the early missions of Chapter 1 in Grand Theft Auto VI, Brian will task Jason with collecting rent from a boutique store/acid lab. You need to find a
articles.body:
During the early missions of Chapter 1 in Grand Theft Auto VI , Brian will task Jason with collecting rent from a boutique store/acid lab. You need to find a code to get into the back room though. Here's how to find the code.

This page takes place after the start of one of the main missions in Chapter 1. For help with starting and finishing this mission either side of finding the lab code, check out IGN's official Lab Fees Walkthrough guide page.

To start Lab Fees, open the map and select the objective "Collect Brian’s Rent" as your next destination.

Once you arrive, call Brian, and walk inside, you'll need to talk to the Clerk.

Hold L2 / LT and speak with the clerk. Jason asks for the rent, and the clerk says he doesn’t have it. As they talk, it’s clear he’s not interested in paying either way.

Here, you have the option to Defuse the situation or Threaten. Here’s what happens:

Defuse : If you defuse the situation, the clerk brushes you off again. Then, he pulls out a bat. Grab it and the clerk gets scared immediately. He’ll say again he doesn’t have the money, but tells you to take his acid that’s locked in the back room.

Threaten : If you threaten immediately, the clerk pulls out a bat. You can grab it, draw your weapon, or you can punch the clerk. If you drew your weapon he’ll immediately surrender. If you went the melee route, by the second punch he’ll surrender and tell you he doesn’t have the money. He instead offers the acid that’s locked in the back room as payment.

Just because GTA 6 gives you two options doesn’t mean there are only two ways to solve a problem. Depending on how you’re approaching playing, you may have figured that out here.

Knock out or kill the clerk : Well.. you really escalated things, didn’t you? No matter how you dispose of the clerk, you’re going to need to find Brian’s money. Loot the clerk for $5 (that’s not going to cover it). There’s a locked room behind the register that has the payment, but you’re going to need to find the door code. Go to the worktable in the corner of the shop and pick up the notepad. Flip it over and you’ll see a sticky note with the code 0420 .

If you look in the register after the clerk is out of the way, you’ll only get $12. He really wasn’t making money.

With the clerk out of the way, you can enter the lab in the back of the shop using the door code: 0420 . You’ll need to input each number individually. Once all four are in, the door opens automatically.

Inside the dingy lab, you’ll find four bags of acid and a lockbox. You can break the lockbox open without repercussions to get an additional $27.

When you pick up the first bag of acid, Jason pulls out a gym bag. Every time you collect illegal goods, you’ll place them in a bag that has limited capacity. You’ll see the bag’s capacity and the value of its contents in the top right corner of the screen.

That's how to find the lab code during the Lab Fees mission. Check out the Lab Fees Walkthrough page for more details about finishing the quest after this interaction.

articles.title: I've only sold five copies of GTA 6, says Leicester shop owner
articles.summary: Games shop owner Richard Tewksbury says the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 has been a "write-off".
articles.body:
The owner of an independent game shop says he has only sold five copies of the highly anticipated open-world action-adventure Grand Theft Auto 6.

GTA 6, as it is known, is estimated to become the biggest entertainment launch in history following the blockbuster video game's debut on Thursday, after a 13-year wait.

But Richard Tewksbury, who runs Super Game Shack in the Silver Arcade in Leicester, said he had seen "embarrassing" sales of the game because it was only released as a digital download and not on disc.

"People are super, super, super hungry for this game - so it's already doing crazy numbers already - but that's not translated for us," he said.

UK joins in GTA 6 frenzy as game becomes available worldwide

GTA 6 hacker pleads guilty after release from secure hospital

"I've only sold four copies on PS5 and one copy on Xbox," added Tewksbury.

"It's because it's all digital - no-one sadly wants to buy a code in a box. We gave it a little go, but they just knocked it dead with making it digital. For game shops, it's a write-off.

"I'm really behind the game - I think it's amazing - but for shops, it's just not great."

In June, developer Rockstar Games said physical copies would contain a code for a digital download rather than the more traditional format. The company has been contacted for comment.

Tewksbury said, while he thinks the game is "amazing", the choice to not sell physical copies with discs was "not great" for smaller stores.

The release of the blockbuster came after two delays to its initial launch date in autumn 2025.

In advance of the launch, GTA 6 generated an estimated £1.25bn ($1.65bn) in revenue based on an estimated 17.07 million units sold, sales tracker SensorTower said .

However, Tewksbury said sales at local stores had been poor because physical editions contained download codes rather than discs.

"It is possibly the biggest game hype there's ever been - 13 years people have been waiting for this," he said.

GTA 6 is one of the first major games to only be released without a traditional disc version.

However, Tewksbury said the reality for game shops was that this style of release would be the future of the industry.

Many consoles are now without physical disc drives and PlayStation announced in July that its games would no longer be released on discs from January 2028 .

Sony, which owns PlayStation, said the move came "as consumer preferences and the broader entertainment industry continue to shift away from physical discs to digital".

"This is the way it's going to be," Tewksbury said.

"It's a big effect for us because it was such a massive game - everyone wants it.

"A lot of people aren't even aware that you could actually get it as a code in a box in a shop.

"Suddenly everyone's already pre-ordered it months in advance because the download is so large and [they] aren't thinking about us."

There was frustration from many gamers when it was announced that there would be no disc copies of GTA 6.

Rob Spence, physical media collector and TikToker, said there was "outrage" over more games being released without a disc.

"There're so many great benefits to physical media," he told BBC Radio Leicester.

"For me personally, it's that ability to touch, to hold, to really admire the artwork that goes into the casing and how it's all put together.

"I always think there's nothing better than walking into a room and seeing a library or a shelf full of great pieces in a collection that can't ever be taken away from you.

"There are so many great retailers out there, like the shop in Leicester, people should go and support them.

Spence, from Rothley in Leicestershire, said town and cities might see "another wave" of closures, if stores did not find ways of further diversifying as sales of physical games decreased.

"It's a very sad thought and unfortunately, this is just the first wave of these types of releases," he said.

"We are now going to see more of this in 2027, and then we're going to see a lot more of it in 2028."

He added the gaming community could lose its "sense of belonging" that came with the stores.

"We all remember that community feel these shops should have, whether you came in at 10am on a Saturday with your pocket money to buy a latest release - we're going to miss all that," he said.

"But we're also now going to miss the midnight releases, when again, there was that sense of community, that sense of belonging.

"That sort of party atmosphere to be one of the first to get your hands on a game - that will all go."

articles.title: The LEGO Exclusive Eeyore Set Is Getting Discounted Ahead of Retirement
articles.body:
LEGO revealed a new lineup of Winnie the Pooh sets back in March in anticipation of the bear's 100th anniversary. What you may not know, however, is that LEGO had already released an Eeyore set back in 2025 as part of the BrickHeadz theme. Now that it's been on the market for a while, LEGO has officially marked it for retirement at the end of the year.

Before that day comes, LEGO is currently offering a discount on the set ahead of its own Black Friday sale . You can get 20% off the set, which drops the price down to just $10.30 for as long as stock remains.

LEGO Eeyore is made up of only 156-pieces and is fairly easy to put together. The BrickHeadz line is essentially a Funko Pop competitor, so this set is entirely meant to be displayed on a desk or a shelf somewhere. It's the only Eeyore set that exists right now, but there are rumors that LEGO is planning a 1,600-piece Eeyore set for March 2027 . As with most LEGO rumors, it's most likely true. The rumored price for that set is $150 though.

If you want to grab a cool Disney gift for the Winnie the Pooh fan in your life, it's a lot cheaper to buy this set before it retires than wait for the expensive version. At $10.39, this is an easy recommendation as a stocking stuffer worth buying for the holidays.

I make this recommendation knowing full well how many secret Eeyore fans exist in the world. My 2-year-old son brings his beloved Eeyore plushie with him everywhere and often refers to him as his "good friend". Because of this, I regularly get strangers talking to me about how Eeyore was their favorite Pooh character too. If you would have asked me a few years ago who I think most people's favorite Pooh character was, I would have probably said Tigger or Pooh. But the times have changed.

Now that I've rewatched all of the Winnie the Pooh movies and read the books again, though, I have to agree that Eeyore is the best one. He's a loyal friend, he's surprising up for anything, and his self-depreciation only adds to his lovability. He deserves all the love he gets.

articles.title: As Yellowjackets Enters Its Final Season, the End Can’t Come Soon Enough
articles.summary: Review: As Yellowjackets enters Season 4, the end can’t come soon enough.
articles.body:
Spoilers follow for Yellowjackets Season 4, Episode 1 – “Hivemind,” which is streaming now on Paramount+. New episodes drop weekly on Fridays.

In 2012, Showtime delivered Yellowjackets , its best original horror drama since Dexter . Featuring a female-led cast of middle-aged legends (Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci, etc.) and mostly unknowns playing their younger selves, Yellowjackets earned instant buzz for its scary mix of survival horror, social hierarchy commentary and trauma manifestations. So it’s been hugely disappointing that the subsequent two seasons have only offered diminishing returns as creators Ashley Lyle and Bart Nickerson (Narcos) haven’t been able to extend the potency of their original premise into coherent and compelling past and present narratives walking into Season 4.

As this is the final season, there was plenty of hope that the writing team would pour all of their reserved ideas into purposeful and emotionally rewarding narratives ignited by the plane crash survivors getting rescued from their feral, cannibalistic ways in the Canadian wilderness. Let’s be real: their return to society has long been past due as they’ve killed or eaten two-thirds of the cast. The fourth season premiere episode, “Hivemind,” crackles with the excitement of that anticipated reentry, told through 1998-era TV breaking news announcements, including Gen Z stalwart MTV News. But then Yellowjackets falls back into its bad habits, like leaning on needle drop montages to Nirvana’s “Where Did You Sleep Last Night” to show the broken and battered survivors being examined in the hospital, instead of giving them meaty scenes where they can process the moment with consequential words and deeds.

The present day storyline picks up in the aftermath of Melissa’s (Hilary Swank) murder of Van (Lauren Ambrose). The formerly hidden in plain sight survivor grabs her wife Alex (Jaylee Hamidi) and young daughter to flee the retribution of Tai (Cypress), Shauna (Lynskey) and Misty (Ricci). However, that’s fear wasted because the trio are a rather listless group now. Tai and Misty don’t trust Shauna anymore so they’re quietly plotting, black comedy style, to make their unstable frenemy believably “disappear.”

Shauna has ostracized everyone in her life, including her estranged husband Jeff (Warren Kole) and fellow murderous daughter Callie (Sarah Desjardins). With nothing else to do, she continues to scream at the world, as evidenced by several slightly humorous scenes where Lynskey gives it her all in displaying Shauna’s hair-trigger and unapologetic rage. Unfortunately, surface anger is all the writers are giving Lynskey to play in these early episodes, so there’s no nuance or pathos to make any of it feel scary or even sympathetic. Though it’s clear the writers think Shauna is a punk rock paragon of female retribution, they’re only giving her cartoonish scenarios to express herself, which doesn’t temper the fact that she’s a multi-murderer with deep issues that keep getting kicked down the narrative road – likely to the last episodes of this season.

While two parallel plots have always been plenty for the series — and out of balance interest- wise since the middle of Season 2 — the writers have introduced another side plot to just before the soccer team survivors are rescued. These surprise asides fill in the unknown details between the hunt for Mari (Alexa Barajas) and Nat’s (Sophie Thatcher) success in using the satellite phone in the Season 3 finale. But to be frank, who cares? The past is the past and these extra tidbits don’t move the needle in absolving these kids of the multitude of sins they’ve already agreed to keep to themselves. The show is giving precious story real estate to the minutiae instead of leaning into scenes happening after their New Jersey return, and it’s baffling filler.

Yellowjackets Season 4 has 10 episodes to land wherever this is going, and so far, the episodes aren’t making a case that this couldn’t have just all wrapped up a season earlier. The groundwork is obviously being set for an escalation between an unrepentant Melissa and rage-monster Shauna, with Tai and Misty as cagey observers. Hopefully, that builds into something plausible and worthwhile, because the 1998 reentry story for the survivors is already meandering and so slow that nothing of note is revealed that we don’t already know from prior seasons. It’s filling in gaps and that’s not great television.

articles.title: Cyberleek Returns for GTA 6 Launch to Reportedly Release a Near-Complete Xbox Build, Threatens to Release the Game's Executable in Days
articles.summary: Cyberleek has returned for the launch of GTA 6 to allegedly release a near complete Xbox build of the game — and has threatened to release its executable in just days.
articles.body:
Cyberleek has returned for the launch of GTA 6 to allegedly release a near complete Xbox build of the game — and has threatened to release its executable in just days.

It was thought that the person or group responsible for the online Cyberleek persona had ended their spate of GTA 6 leaks last month, after their memecoin crashed despite efforts to boost its market cap.

In October, Cyberleek had tied various types of GTA 6 gameplay leaks to the Cyberleek market cap, and threatened to release a build of the game — supposedly over 200 GB in size — if the memecoin hit a $30 million market cap. Gameplay clips reportedly leaked at the time allegedly showed Lucia fully naked — something that is not possible in the final launch version of the game.

Yesterday, November 19 — the GTA 6 release date — Cyberleek returned to drop a GTA 6 Xbox build without the game's executable. In a statement reportedly published online , Cyberleek claimed this Xbox build is a “full November 2026 build of GTA 6.” They predicted this Xbox build would be used to emulate GTA 6 on PC “within a week, running far past 30fps.”

The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.

Cyberleek has revived their crypto scheme, promising to release the executable immediately if it hits a $15 million market cap. While the CyberLeek memecoin was boosted in value by the news to $1.9 million yesterday, it is unlikely to get anywhere near the target.

Still, Cyberleek has vowed to release the final file anyway on November 23, whether the memecoin hits the market cap or not.

The release of a full and recent build of GTA 6 would of course be hugely damaging for Rockstar and parent company Take-Two, which appears to have been unable to deter Cyberleek’s actions in any meaningful way since their spate of leaks began.

It would also run counter to the thought that Cyberleek only had access to an early development build of GTA 6, a feeling that was reinforced not only by the videos that were released, but by the differences that have emerged following the game’s official launch.

Fans are calling on people not to spend money on Cyberleek, pointing out the leaker cashed out back in August and did again in October. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker cashing out having earnt around $270,000.

IGN had reported on fan skepticism around the alleged leaked gameplay that reportedly showed both Jason and Lucia fully naked . A previous leaked gameplay video allegedly showed a tank spawning into the world, which suggested access to a dev menu of some kind. The leaked videos allegedly showing both Jason and Lucia fully naked also show NPCs failing to react to that in any way, which suggested this effect was achieved with either a dev menu or cheats.

Cyberleek had threatened Rockstar and Take-Two with the release of a full playthrough of the game’s story if they failed to release GTA 6 on-disc and issue a public apology — and the market cap of the memecoin hit $30 million. Of course, few believe these GTA 6 leaks are about campaigning for physical media — rather they're about making money from a crypto scam.

Cyberleek appeared to go dark after a spate of high-profile GTA 6 leaks in August that sparked an investigation from Take-Two. The company issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of the hunt for the person or group of people responsible. It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, or any potential build of the game it's taken from, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security.

In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks , describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19.

articles.title: Rosario Dawson Shows First Look at Return as Claire Temple in Spider-Man: Brand New Day Extended Cut
articles.summary: Rosario Dawson has shared the first look at her return as Claire Temple in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, marking her long-awaited comeback to the MCU.
articles.body:
Rosario Dawson has shared the first look at her return as Claire Temple in Spider-Man: Brand New Day , marking her long-awaited comeback to the MCU.

Warning! Spoilers for Spider-Man: Brand New Day follow...

Posting on Instagram , Dawson revealed a photo of her in costume for her first Marvel appearance in a decade, standing in nurse scrubs next to Tom Holland's Spider-Man. It's a scene that fans thought they'd never get to see, after it was deleted from the final cut of the movie , disappointing those waiting for Dawson's reappearance.

Now, however, it is being reinstated for the film's extended edition re-release , entitled Spider-Man: [Brand New] Brand New Day, alongside a handful of other moments previously left on the cutting room floor.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Our Biggest Burning Questions

"It's a brand new BRAND NEW DAY with our friendly neighborhood Spider-Man...!" Dawson wrote. "So excited to enjoy this record-breaking movie on the big screen (starting on December 4th) with an extended cut of new scenes and surprises… Ahhhh!

"Join me in getting tickets NOW!!!" Dawson continued. "PS: mom can finally share her bts photos❣️"

It's pretty obvious when this scene will take place, as Dawson's character stands next to Tom Holland's Spider-Man who is wearing a hospital gown and his Spidey mask. Of course, Spider-Man finds himself in hospital towards the end of the movie, and Dawson's return will likely answer fan questions surrounding how the superhero got patched up with no one else discovering his identity. (The answer, surely, is that Dawson takes care of him directly — having been used to keeping numerous superhero identities secret in the past.)

Debuting in the very first season of Daredevil back in 2015, Dawson’s no-nonsense nurse quickly became an indispensable ally across its sister Netflix shows: Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, Iron Fist, and The Defenders. Whether she was patching up Matt Murdock in a dimly lit apartment, helping Luke Cage navigate Harlem, or standing her ground against The Hand, Claire earned a fan following for her work sewing up the wounds of New York's vigilante community.

However, after her appearance in the second season of Luke Cage in 2018, Dawson stepped away from the role, leaving fans wondering for years whether Claire Temple would ever cross paths with the broader MCU. With Charlie Cox’s Matt Murdock and Jon Bernthal’s Frank Castle re-entering the fold, Dawson’s return felt like a missing puzzle piece — and Spider-Man: Brand New Day is finally delivering on that promise.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day will be back in theaters on December 4, 2026, now with Rosario Dawson included. What else has Marvel added back into the movie? You'll just have to go along and find out.

articles.title: GTA 6 Players Find Red Dead Redemption Lore That Strongly Suggests Both Series Are Set in the Same Universe
articles.summary: Players have found lore in GTA 6 that strongly suggest the game takes place in the same universe as Rockstar’s Red Dead Redemption series, in a move that has excited fans about the prospect of a canon merger of timelines.
articles.body:
Players have found lore in GTA 6 that strongly suggest the game takes place in the same universe as Rockstar’s Red Dead Redemption series, in a move that has excited fans about the prospect of a canon merger of timelines.

Warning! Spoilers for GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption 2 follow.

We’ve already found Arthur Morgan’s hat in GTA 6, but there’s another thing connecting the two games. A readable book found in Brian’s Marina in Key Lento has multiple references to Red Dead Redemption and its sequel. X / Twitter user GameRoll shared excerpts from the book online. The book is a chronicle of the life and death of Flaco Hernandez, a gunslinger Arthur Morgan hunts to his cabin by Cairn Lake in Grizzlies West during the The Noblest of Men, and a Woman stranger mission in RDR 2. The book itself could even be the chronicle you help Theodore Levin write by hunting down the gunslingers, or at least a modern reinterpretation of it.

It’s told from the viewpoint of Rust McCreary, an original character who doesn’t appear in either RDR game. In the book, he comes across the corpse of Hernandez in the snow at Cairn Lake, right where you leave him in the RDR 2 mission.

According to the book, Hernandez had a bullet hole right in the center of his forehead, so it’s canon that you can actually aim good. The book also references multiple locations, from New Austin to Armadillo and Blackwater.

It’s not quite confirmation that Jason is a direct descendant of Arthur Morgan or anything like that, but it’s a cool detail that basically turns RDR into a prequel to GTA 4 and its sequels. Like Dutch, Rockstar had a plan all along. Players have even found license plates for New Austin in GTA 6 . New Austin is one of the states in which Red Dead takes place, and is assumed to be Rockstar's version of Texas.

It's not the first time Rockstar has connected the games. In the first iteration of GTA Online, the character creator allowed you to share genetics with John Marston, protagonist of the first RDR, to create a visual basis for your original character. Fans of the two games are generally happy with the connection. "Honestly? Good," said one X / Twitter user . "I was annoyed that technically both canons weren't linked. By linking them, it makes the universe feel bigger."

"That is so cool," said another . "This GTA trully feels like RDR. And I really enjoy the calmer aproach I even try to be as good with jason to give them the better possible ending." articles.title: The Percy Jackson Season 3 Premiere Is a Promising Start to the First Adaptation of Rick Riordan's Third Book
articles.summary: Review: The Percy Jackson Season 3 premiere is a promising start to the first adaptation of Rick Riordan's third book.
articles.body:
The first two episodes of Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3 debut on Disney+ on Friday, November 20.

The premiere of Percy Jackson Season 3 marks the first time an adaptation has made it past the second novel in Rick Riordan's series . For those who haven't read The Titan's Curse, you'll notice there's a shift in tone right off the bat. The characters are older, the stakes feel higher, and everything has gotten a bit more serious. The start of Season 3 brings that much-needed weight to the story, largely thanks to how well the cast has grown into their roles.

The first two episodes act as the setup for the main quest of Season 3. We get a proper introduction to Thalia as a key player, as well as new characters like Nico, Bianca, Artemis, Apollo, and Atlas. The premiere largely succeeds in its effort to kick off the story, and by the end of Episode 2 I found myself genuinely excited for more.

Walker Scobell has been a delightful Percy Jackson since Season 1 , but he's only gotten better with experience. Whenever Percy is interacting with his friends or the gods themselves, all of the moving parts of the story seem to click in place. Tamara Smart also makes for a great Thalia, acting as the perfect counterbalance to Percy. These are two equally powerful demigods who are learning to deal with each other's existence, and the tension definitely comes through. The most engaging moments of the first two episodes are when the son of Poseidon and the daughter of Zeus find themselves at odds—which is pretty much constantly.

Godlike powers are also on full display in Season 3. Percy has had time to grow into his abilities and we get a taste of that in the very first scene. Now that Thalia is no longer stuck as a tree, we also get to see a spark of Zeus' wrath in action. Director James Bobin does an excellent job of incorporating these magical elements in a way that doesn't feel overdone. Getting to see Percy subtly block an arrow with a splash of water or Thalia paralyze a few enemies with a bit of lightning is quite fun to watch and also builds perfectly toward the massive clash of power that Percy and Thalia's rocky start was leading us to the whole time. These characters are really starting to feel less like kids and more like dangerous half-bloods you don't want to mess with.

While the core performances are excellent throughout, the series stumbles a bit in these first two episodes when the gods take center stage. Dafne Keen does a decent job of embodying Artemis' intensity, but she feels a bit out of pace with the rest of the cast when she's actually interacting with them. This feeling is further intensified by her very uncomfortable interactions with her brother Apollo (Hubert Smielecki) that just aren't believable at all. Thankfully these moments are a pretty minor occurrence and don't weigh down the rest of the story for long. Jason Mantzoukas' Dionysus is, of course, the exception to this and I loved every moment he had on screen so far.

articles.title: Can Jason and Lucia Get Naked in GTA 6?
articles.summary: Let’s settle this once and for all. Can Jason and Lucia get naked in GTA 6?
articles.body:
Let’s settle this once and for all. Can Jason and Lucia get naked in GTA 6 ?

Ever since the couple were revealed as the co-protagonists of GTA 6, it feels like that one question has been asked more than any other. Not, “How will the robbery gameplay systems work?” or, “Does the driving feel as exquisitely dangerous as it did in GTA 4?,” but instead, people just want to know how much skin will be on show.

Who am I to judge? Upon booting up GTA 6 for the first time, within its opening hours I’d already located one nudist bar and spent a little too long examining the variety of appendages on show. There’s no shortage of NPC nudity out there in Leonida. People walk along beaches, run out into the street, and sit by pools with no clothes covering their decency. But, how about Jason and Lucia?

If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

Showering can (and should, if you don’t want to stink) play a huge part in your daily routine in GTA 6. Not only does it boost your focus bar, but can have other gameplay ramifications, such as enemy humans and animals being able to pick up your scent more easily.

Of course, showering should be done with no clothes on — unless you’re playing the Japanese version of Grand Theft Auto 6, that is — and you can scrub up both Jason and Lucia from a camera view deliberately angled so you don’t get a good look around the front of them. I’m sure you’ve tried by now if you’re reading this, but no matter how forcefully you push that right stick, you’ll never get the angle you’re looking for. GTA 6 simply does not want you to see its lead character’s genitals. They bare their soul in their epic story, so this is the least grace we can give them.

Sex can play a big part in Jason and Lucia’s story if you choose to engage in it, though. Build a strong enough relationship between them, and you’ll occasionally get a prompt to engage in a spot of physical intimacy, whether that be in bed, in the shower, on the sofa, or other spots around the house. While, again, these scenes aren’t overly explicit with full frontal nudity never on show, both can be naked, with topless scenes not uncommon. If nipples are what you’re seeking, you shall find them.

So, can you see Jason and Lucia naked? Yes, and no. Intimate scenes often involve no clothes, but you’re never going to come close to watching a porn film here. That would just be odd.

The least you can ever walk around your home wearing is underwear, and if you try to leave the house, further clothes will be magically added to your character to spare their decency. Despite some wild and weird things available for you to find in GTA 6’s open world, it ultimately does want you to treat its leads as real humans, not complete freaks. Despite what some past leaks may have suggested , you can’t roam the streets of Vice City completely nude for all the world to see. You are, however, free to do that in real life, but you will likely end up in jail.

articles.summary: After an extended wait, the sequel to 'GTA 5' is out and people are stoked.
articles.body: Grand Theft Auto VI is here at last, and gamers around the world can finally play after it launched Thursday. So far, the game, which takes up a whopping 212GB on your PlayStation5 or Xbox, is receiving rave reviews. GTA 6 is streaming all over Twitch, and the memes, clips and hot takes have been pouring in.Digital marketing firm Sensor Tower estimates that GTA 6 generated $2.36 billion in pre-orders and first-day sales, with approximately 24.5 million copies sold following its Thursday release. GTA 6 costs $79.99 for PS5 and Xbox, with an "ultimate" version priced at $99.99. Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two have yet to confirm official sales figures but described demand as "unprecedented."Players began pre-loading GTA 6 last week, even though they probably had to clear some space on their consoles. Millions of people are expected to take time off work and school to play GTA 6.
